name: DODGE! (INSTRUCTIONS BELOW↓)
author: MachoriusL
description: The aim of this game is to collide with as many green cubes as you can, WATCH OUT! There are black cubes that you must dodge to survive! Use the A,D or left and right arrow keys to move the red ball from side to side.If you are not comfortable with this view change the camera's position by clicking C key. This game is never-ending, try to get as many points as you can and play as many times as you want! It puts your focus, patience and reflexes to the test. Have fun!
